rooms.name: Map Room
rooms.desc: There's a map here for immortal use.

rooms.name: A Turn in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The stone corridor curves east and south here. From somewhere in the
distance, you hear the sound of a large roaring, as if from some great
beast.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The corridor turns sharply to the west, and continues eastward. It's
dark as pitch, and every hall looks the same.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The hallway continues east and west, and the sounds of your boots ring
loudly on the stone floor.  The sound carries well, as you can hear the
sounds of other creatures moving elsewhere in the darkness.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The stone hallway leads east and west into darkness.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This corridor stretches interminably, yet seems to be leading due east
and west, though it's hard to tell after being down here for any length of
time.  Your sense of direction is lost in this darkness.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This corridor stretches interminably, yet seems to be leading due east
and west, though it's hard to tell after being down here for any length of
time.  Your sense of direction is lost in this darkness.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This corridor stretches interminably, yet seems to be leading due east
and west, though it's hard to tell after being down here for any length of
time.  Your sense of direction is lost in this darkness.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The corridor opens into a large room to the east, and continues back
into darkness to the west.

rooms.name: A Large Room in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This large room is seemingly hollowed out of solid stone, but by whose
hand is unknown.  The craftsmanship looks nothing like the careful work of
dwarves, nor does it look like it was done by any type of tool you've ever
seen. It almost looks CLAWED out by something. Eyeing the debris on the 
floor in front of you, you feel like this is the home of that something.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The stone hall turns eastward to the north, and continues southward
into darkness.

rooms.name: A Turn in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The stone corridor curves east and south here.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This hallway is strewn with garbage and bones, most of which are so
old that they don't stink - much.  The hall leads east and turns south
west of here.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The garbage-lined hall is quite long, leading east and west. The trash 
gets deeper to the east.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The trash and debris in the hall are about knee-deep here. The rough stone
walls are turning slimy and black from all the rotting garbage.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The garbage reaches crotch-deep levels in this part of the hall. You probe
gently ahead for pitfalls.  Sinking into this mess would be like bathing in
a toilet.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
Wading through the waist-high garbage, you suddenly think of MANY things
you'd rather be doing. Actually, you can't think of anything much worse. 
The hall continues east and west.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The maze of halls continues into deep trash to the west, and turns
southward east of here. The level of stench and refuse is less in that
direction.

rooms.name: A Turn In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The slimy, rough rock tunnel turns south and west here, both ways as
dark as a bat's wings.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The rough stone walls of the labyrinth allow you to continue north and
south.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The rough stone walls of the labyrinth allow you to continue north and
south.

rooms.name: The Noisy Cave
rooms.desc:
The source of the screeching that echoed through the labyrinth can be
found here, in the midst of its own waste and corpses of tons of rats.
The exit is to the east.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
A loud screeching fills your ears from the west. The rat population
seems much less dense here.

rooms.name: In the Labrinth
rooms.desc:
The rats that have milling about your feet seem to disperse at some
unseen signal. Suddenly, a loud screech fills your ears from the west.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The stone corridor that entombs you leads east and west. A loud animal's
screech pierces the air from the west, and the tunnel makes a sharp turn to
the east.

rooms.name: A Turn in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The corridor turns here, leading south and west.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This long stone corridor turns just north of here, and continues south
past the extent of your light.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The rough stone walls of the labyrinth allow you to continue north or
south.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
A large junction of passages is to the south, and the current hallway
continues north.

rooms.name: A Furnished Room In The Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
Strangely out of place, this room is lit by the soft glow of candles,
and is home to a bed, chair, table, and several other domestic necessities.
A fresh pot of rat stew boils over a small fire that fills the room with
acrid smoke.

rooms.name: In The Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
Smoke rolls out of a lit room to the west.  The labyrinth continues to
the east.

rooms.name: A Junction In The Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The tunnel splits east, south, and west here. Smoke fills the chamber
and becomes thicker to the west.

rooms.name: In The Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
There is a split in the tunnels to the west, and the corridor dead-ends
to the east.

rooms.name: A Dead End In The Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The corridor comes to a end here, at a large pile of refuse teeming
with rats and other vermin.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The stone tunnel turns to the north, and opens into a junction south
of here.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The stone tunnel leads north and south into darkness.

rooms.name: A Junction in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This large junction has passages leading off in all directions but west,
yet none of them look more inviting than another.  To the east there may
be another junction but it's just too dark to tell.

rooms.name: A Junction in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This huge room has exits in all directions - large openings to the north
and east, and two smaller ones to the south and west.  Huge rats, although
fearless of humanoids, still skitter away from your light.

rooms.name: A Turn in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The corridors lead south and westward here. The steady sound of dripping
water rises from the south (along with a horrid stench), and a large series
of junctions opens to the west. A steady tide of rats run from your light
as you approach, and nip at your heels as you pass.

rooms.name: A Turn in the Labrinth
rooms.desc:
The tunnel opens into a junction to the north, and turns southward east
of here.

rooms.name: A Turn in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The stone tunnel leads west and south here.

rooms.name: A Turn in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The stone tunnel leads east and south here.

rooms.name: A Junction in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The tunnel branches off north, west and south here.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The stone tunnel leads north and south into darkness.

rooms.name: A Narrow Corridor in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This tunnel is more narrow than others you've seen, and seems to narrow
into no more than a crack to the south.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This small tunnel is packed with fat rats, all scampering over each other
to get out of your way. A junction opens up to the north, and southward the
tunnel continues.

rooms.name: A Wet Corridor in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This north-south corridor is filled with the stench of raw sewage.
Unfortunately for you, its also filled WITH raw sewage. Brown muck
covers your boots and leggings. The rats everywhere seem to love it.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This corridor runs north and south. The scent of smoke fills the air from
the north.

rooms.name: A Dead End in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The tunnel stops abruptly here at a dead end.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: This corridor runs north and south. There's a junction to the north.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This corridor runs north and south - or are you walking in circles?
It's too dark to tell.

rooms.name: A Dead End in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The already narrow rock tunnel narrows down to just a slit in the wall
here.  You can continue back north, or squeeze into the misty blackness to
the west.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The labyrinth turns sharply just south of here, and continues back north.
The endless chittering of the rats is beginning to grate on your nerves.

rooms.name: A Dead End in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
A steady stream of liquid waste flows from a hole in the ceiling here,
much too small for you to crawl through, even if you could stomach it. A 
pool of sludge fills the room, serving as a great breeding ground for the
denizens of the labyrinth.

rooms.name: A Dead End in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The tunnel suddenly ends here.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: This tunnel runs east and west. There's a dead end to the west.

rooms.name: A Junction in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
This triple junction leads north, south, and west. None of the passages
look too appealing.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: You are in a rough stone corridor that leads east and turns south.

rooms.name: A Junction in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: This triple junction leads north, south, and west.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The rough stone corridor leads north and south.

rooms.name: A Turn in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The stone passage leads north and east here.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The narrow corridor leads east and west.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The narrow corridor leads east and west.

rooms.name: In the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The narrow corridor leads east and west.

rooms.name: A Turn in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The stone passage leads north and west here.

rooms.name: A Dead End in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc:
The tunnel suddenly ends here at a rush of water spouting from a hole
in the ceiling.

rooms.name: A Turn in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The stone passage leads north and east here.

rooms.name: A Turn in the Labyrinth
rooms.desc: The stone passage leads north and west here.
